opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an exceptional, independent researcher with a strong track record, hold a permanent or fixed‑term UK university or not‑for‑profit position, have teaching and admin duties, and be based in the UK. Co‑applicants (up to two) must be independent researchers from a different Academy remit, also on a permanent or fixed‑term UK position.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary cross‑Academy scheme supporting established researchers to pursue curiosity‑driven research that integrates social sciences, humanities, natural sciences and engineering. Awards up to 24 months, up to £200,000.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher at any career stage who can demonstrate prior public‑engagement experience. Must not have received a previous SHAPE award.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects with GLAM or performing‑arts partners, encouraging new approaches to sharing humanities and social‑science research with audiences.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at UK or German institutions.
opportunities.summary: Travel‑funded attendance for up to 15 UK and 15 German early‑career scholars at a three‑day symposium on “Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future”, with seed‑funding for post‑symposium collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or research organisation, who have completed their viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027 and are not permanently appointed.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to support independent research leading to a publishable output, funded by DSIT covering 80 % of salary and indirect costs.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO, resident in the UK, working in the humanities or social sciences. Lead applicants must hold a permanent or long‑term post; co‑applicants may be UK or overseas.
opportunities.summary: Six‑ to twelve‑month awards to develop new quantitative, data‑science, digital‑humanities or language skills, supporting interdisciplinary methodological development.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences (post‑doctoral level or above) with an eligible UK institution, collaborating with at least one overseas co‑applicant; interdisciplinary collaboration required.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects on the theme of Mobilities, involving any SHAPE or STEM discipline, with up to £300k funding (80 % FEC).

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; no specific disciplinary restriction; must be able to work at DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP, offering up to £150k to develop policy‑relevant research in security, Indo‑European relations, technology/AI, or European strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible with justification)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months; must meet eligibility of the target award.
opportunities.summary: One‑off funding to support additional needs such as equipment, caring costs, or assistance with applying for a British Academy award.
